description: The Go certification runner's checks held in step with the TypeScript suite's (agent#53): every check of the describe.each(MODEL_ENGINES) blocks of packages/harness/certification/conformance.test.ts, by its block and its name, every check of packages/harness/certification/scenarios.test.ts, by its name, and every check of packages/harness/certification/delegation.test.ts, by its name, mapped to the Go checks that make it (the engine leg's LegResult.Checks by CheckNames; each other block's Check by its name, LegChecks; each scenario's ScenarioCheck names) or to the reason Go does not run it. parity_test.go reads the three TypeScript files and fails where one has a check this table lacks, where this table names one it does not have, or where a Go check is named that the runner does not make. agentCapability lists the Go checks of the agent capability (ADR-0007) that have no TypeScript counterpart, each with the item of agent#67's acceptance list it holds; parity_test.go holds the list to the runner's AgentOwnNames.
